content: I've just opened my first PR #43281, proving Hurwitz's theorem from Diophantine approximation. It skips the continued fractions route for the Farey brackets, which makes the proof rather more elementary. Would appreciate a review!
Hi, I'm still looking for a review on this. It's been unassigned twice due to inactivity so if anyone has the time to look through it I'd be very grateful.
I might suggest that it is better to define a Farey pair of rationals followed by using the interval API instead of using a real together with a 4-tuple of integers.
